prior_year_events.impact_description: The report refers to reserve releases coming from 2012 and prior years (run-off/closure improvement).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2014 with a net positive result driven principally by favourable runoff on prior years. The report describes releases from older underwriting years (2012 and prior) and notes recoveries/reconciliations with reinsurers as contributors to the improvement. No single quantified gross prioryear movement was clearly presented in the gross movement notes available in the scanned pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned images had limited legibility. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Liabilities) prior-year column (2013) total gross 'Claims outstanding' = 130,318 (thousands)  130.318m (page 16). An explicit GROSS prioryear movement figure (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was not clearly legible in the scanned pages / notes; the report narrative refers to releases from 2012 and prior years but does not present an unambiguous gross PYD number in the visible notes. The only clearly tabulated prior-year related number visible in the profit & loss technical account is 'Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' (a P&L line) which is NOT a prioryear reserve movement per the extraction rules and therefore was NOT used. The gross premium mix by statutory class was not presented as a multi-line segmental table in clearly legible form in the scanned pages; a single aggregate gross written premium (42,243) is taken from the segmental/summary table (page 22) and presented here as a single line (mix from divisional/summary). Many detailed tables (technical provisions movement, claims development triangle) were not legible enough to extract a reliable gross PYD or a claims development triangle; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null and the claims triangle is reported as none.
